description.value: Nook Restaurant (Shipyards) is an Italian neighbourhood restaurant in North Vancouver's Shipyards district, serving housemade pasta, pizza, antipasto, and cocktails with locally sourced ingredients and Italian imports. Part of a Metro Vancouver chain founded in 2009, this location sits in the lively Shipyards waterfront area — a natural stop for cyclists riding the North Shore. Dine-in, pickup, and delivery are all available, and the restaurant is wheelchair accessible.
